newsitem.title: PERU: RESEARCH ALERT - Santander starts Edegel.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Santander starts Edegel.

text.p: Santander Investment said Monday it had started coverage of Peruvian electricity generator Edegel with a market perform rating.
-- "Santander expects earnings per share of $0.03 and $0.04 for 1997 and 1998, respectively," it said in a statement. "In 1996, the company reported earnings of $0.03 per share.
-- "The 12- to 18-month target price of $0.58 implies 15.2 percent upside from the current level."
-- Santander said Edegel would benefit from growth expected in the Peruvian electricity sector over the next five years.

-- It expects 1997 operating results to be weak due to low water levels and ensuing higher generation costs, but "operating results will rebound in 1998 as a result of the predicted normal winter rainfall," the statement added.
